items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 25 November 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong Winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure building across the Irish sea.


##Wind##

Southeast 4 to 6, decreasing east or southeast 3 to 5 this morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate at first.


##Weather##

Rain in the west of the area at first.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in the west at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southeast 3 to 5, increasing 5 or 6, then 6 to gale 8 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming moderate, then becoming moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain later.
